exclusivity.rule: Major weapon branches are mutually exclusive and irreversible: once the player commits that weapon to one branch, the other two cannot be installed during the same run.

availability.rule: All three branches appear immediately after the weapon is equipped and require no common-ore rank, weapon level, elapsed time, or boss prerequisite.

favorable_scene_effect.qualitative: improves payload efficiency but can leave holes against scattered weak enemies

rules.text: A mine waits until at least three ordinary-equivalent enemies are in radius, or until an elite or boss enters.
Its damage multiplier is `1 + 0.15 × (ordinary-equivalent count − 1)`, capped at 2×. A boss counts as three and an elite as four for this calculation.
An expiring mine detonates with a minimum 1.30× multiplier if any enemy is in radius; otherwise it disappears harmlessly.
This improves payload efficiency but can leave holes against scattered weak enemies.
